Filed under[Recent Investor News](https://compxinternational.com/category/recent-investor-news/) on Jul 14, 2026


DALLAS, TEXAS, July 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — CompX International Inc. (NYSE American: CIX) announced today that, subject to the completion of quarter-end closing procedures, it expects to report second quarter 2026 earnings in a press release after market close on Tuesday, August 4, 2026.


CompX is a leading manufacturer of security products and recreational marine components.
